final: WITH per_player AS (SELECT bp.player_id, p.bats, AVG(bp."double") AS avg_doubles FROM batting_postseason AS bp JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = bp.player_id WHERE p.bats <> '' GROUP BY bp.player_id, p.bats), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_doubles) AS mean_avg FROM per_player), normalized AS (SELECT pp.player_id, pp.bats, pp.avg_doubles, pp.avg_doubles / o.mean_avg AS ratio FROM per_player AS pp CROSS JOIN overall AS o), hand_mean AS (SELECT bats, AVG(ratio) AS mean_ratio FROM normalized GROUP BY bats) SELECT n.player_id, n.bats, n.avg_doubles, n.ratio, n.ratio - h.mean_ratio AS difference FROM normalized AS n JOIN hand_mean AS h ON n.bats = h.bats ORDER BY difference DESC LIMIT 10
